q: Can you give me an example of good teamwork you’ve demonstrated in the past?
a:
In my previous role, I worked with my team during a very busy period when we had many customer requests at the same time. This created a lot of pressure and confusion.

To manage the situation, we quickly organized a team meeting and divided the tasks based on our strengths while staying calm. For example, one teammate focused on technical issues, and I handled customer communication to keep them informed and reassured.

We also supported each other whenever needed, which helped us manage the workload effectively and maintain customer satisfaction.

This experience showed me that communication, trust, and teamwork are essential, especially in high-pressure situations.
